title: Exotic Earthy Middle Eastern Flaxseed Pilaf
description: Savory and aerated one-pot Middle Eastern dish featuring flaxseed, agemono-deep-fry, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, this pilaf is perfect for a unique dinner experience. It combines the earthy flavors of flaxseed and spices with the crunch of deep-fried elements.
instructions: Heat the agemono oil in a large deep pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the grated carrots and chopped zucchini and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the flaxseed, basmati rice, garam masala, cumin, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir well.
Add 4 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Turn off the heat and let the pilaf rest for 5 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
